characterization.apps_api_persistence_gap_concrete_reprod: Ran the actual EconomicImpactPersistence.model_validate() against the REAL v2 JSON shape produced by the real, current scripts/validate_candidates.py for real candidate CAND-001 (the exact call scripts/promote_findings.py:298 makes). Result: raises a real pydantic.ValidationError (13 errors -- 8 'Field required' for the v1 fields it still demands, 5 'Extra inputs are not permitted' for the new v2 fields). This means: today, running the real promote_findings.py pipeline against a validation report produced by the current (post-TASK-086) validate_candidates.py would CRASH, not silently misreport. Confirms and sharpens ADR-090's own disclosed consequence ('a fresh v2 CandidateExposureResult is NOT currently end-to-end promotable through Finding persistence') with a concrete, reproduced failure rather than a theoretical shape mismatch.

characterization.evaluate_benchmark_py_same_category_gap_: scripts/evaluate_benchmark.py's metric-6 extraction (lines 536-548) still does `raw_economic_impact.get('historical_impact')` against the same new v2 shape. Since the v2 shape has no top-level 'historical_impact' key at all (it has 'tier1'/'tier2'/'reportable_tiers'/'attributable_impact' instead), this `.get()` deterministically returns None, `isinstance(None, dict)` is False, and the code raises `ValueError(f'candidate {s.candidate_id} has no bound historical impact')` (line 542) -- confirmed by direct source inspection of this exact, unconditional dict-key lookup, not executed end-to-end (constructing a full valid evaluate_benchmark.py input requires unrelated scoreable-pattern/ground-truth scaffolding out of proportion to this check). This is a SECOND real downstream call site (beyond the one apps/api site ADR-090's own text names) that would fail loud, not silently reinterpret, against a fresh v2 output. It falls under the same 'packages/analytics-only, downstream integration deferred' scope reasoning ADR-090 already applies to apps/api, but is not literally named in that ADR's text -- worth the orchestrating session's awareness that the disclosed gap's blast radius is broader than the one file pair named.

method: (a) Repo-wide grep (not limited to files TASK-086 touched) for historical_impact / EconomicImpactResult / build_economic_impact_result. (b) For the one call site load-bearing enough to actually execute (scripts/promote_findings.py -> apps/api/app/findings/contracts.py's EconomicImpactPersistence.model_validate), ran the REAL Pydantic model against the REAL v2 JSON shape scripts/validate_candidates.py emits today for a real validated candidate (CAND-001), to see concretely whether it silently accepts/misinterprets it or fails loud. overall_finding: No site anywhere in the codebase silently misinterprets or reframes exposure as O3-adjacent 'impact'/'savings' language under the new v2 semantics. The customer-facing product surface was already O1-honest before this task and remains so. Where a downstream consumer has not yet been migrated to the new v2 shape (apps/api/app/findings/contracts.py+schemas.py, scripts/promote_findings.py, scripts/evaluate_benchmark.py), it fails LOUD (a Pydantic ValidationError or an explicit ValueError) rather than silently accepting or reinterpreting the new shape under old semantics. This is real, disclosed integration debt -- a fresh v2 CandidateExposureResult is not currently end-to-end promotable through Finding persistence, nor through the benchmark evaluation script -- but it is not a semantic-conflation defect: nothing silently asserts O1 ~= O2 or O1 ~= O3 anywhere found.
